name: Press Contact Researcher
description: Research launch press/newsletter/podcast/community targets and upsert them into the Press CRM table in Ledger, matched on Outlet.

config.query: indie Mac app press coverage how to pitch tips email MacStories 9to5Mac indie developer app launch

config.userPrompt:
You are researching press outreach targets and writing them into an mChatAI+ Ledger table. Your entire output is the CSV that will be written into it.

TARGET TABLE: Press CRM
KEY COLUMN: Outlet

## Column contract

Emit these headers EXACTLY, in this order, spelled this way:

Outlet,Category,Contact,Method,URL,Angle,Priority,Status,Contacted,FollowUp,Notes

A header you spell differently does not update the existing column — it creates a NEW one. Copy the line above verbatim.

| Column | Means | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Outlet | Publication / show / community name | The upsert key — spell it the way the outlet spells itself |
| Category | One of: press, newsletter, podcast, video, community, local, niche | Closed set — pick the nearest |
| Contact | Person to pitch, if the sources name one | Empty if outlet-level |
| Method | HOW to reach them: a verified email, a submission-form URL, or `unknown` | See the hard rule below |
| URL | The outlet's site or the exact contact/about page | |
| Angle | One line: why THIS outlet would care about THIS product | Specific beats generic — name the beat or column |
| Priority | 1 = a cold pitch realistically lands, 2 = plausible, 3 = long shot | Whole number, 1-3 |
| Status | Always `not contacted` for new rows | Leave existing rows' status alone by omitting rows you have no update for |
| Contacted | Leave EMPTY | Filled in by hand when a pitch goes out |
| FollowUp | Leave EMPTY | Filled in by hand |
| Notes | Posting rules, tip-line quirks, best day to pitch | Empty unless the sources say something usable |

**The email rule is a hard rule.** NEVER construct, guess or pattern-infer an email address (`firstname@outlet.com` is a fabrication). A made-up email is indistinguishable from a real one until the pitch silently bounces — or lands in a stranger's inbox. Write an email into Method ONLY if a source page actually displays it. Otherwise write the contact-form URL, or `unknown` with the best public page in URL.

## What to output

Nothing but CSV. No preamble, no code fence, no trailing commentary. The first line is the header, every following line is one outlet.

## Rules

1. Only outlets the sources below actually support — if they cover 12 outlets, emit 12 rows and stop. Do not fill in more from memory.
2. Drop anything the sources suggest is defunct or dormant.
3. An outlet not in the sources gets no row at all — omitting it leaves any existing row untouched, which is correct.
4. Quote any cell containing a comma; double an inner quote.
5. Priority is honest triage for someone with no PR agency: a tips@ inbox or a self-serve community is a 1; a national desk is a 3.
